description: The Maharashtra government has constituted a 10-member AI, Data Analytics and Dashboard Governance Committee to promote the use of artificial intelligence, predictive analytics and automated decision-support systems in higher and technical education. The panel will also focus on data security, privacy and ethical AI use.
body_lead: Maharashtra Forms AI Governance Committee for Higher Education The Maharashtra government has constituted a 10-member AI, Data Analytics and Dashboard Governance Committee to promote the use of artificial intelligence, predictive analytics and automated decision-support systems in higher and technical education. The panel will also focus on data security, privacy and ethical AI use. The Higher and Technical Education Department constituted the AI, Data Analytics & Dashboard Governance Committee through a Government Resolution issued on September 21.
